name: ThunderPhone
positioning: A newer voice agent platform that runs its own speech-to-speech stack and sells flat, all-inclusive per-minute tiers, with importers for agents built on other platforms.

pricing.model: Prepaid pay-as-you-go with three flat per-minute engine tiers (Spark, Bolt, Storm) and optional per-minute add-ons; no subscription or seat fee.
pricing.headline: From 2 cents per minute (Spark), 5 cents (Bolt) and 9 cents (Storm), all-inclusive of transcription, model and standard voices; add-ons such as premium voices apply extra.
planNotes: Prepaid and pay-as-you-go; no platform fee, subscription or seat fee.
Hold time bills at a flat 2 cents per minute on every tier.

Optional add-ons: Storm extra intelligence +3 cents, Storm verbal acknowledgement +2 cents, supervision +4 cents, selected-language or premium voice up to +3 cents, long prompts beyond 5,000 tokens +1 to +2 cents per block, ThunderPhone number usage +1 cent per minute.
Enterprise: custom rates, the vendor says 1 cent per minute or less is possible for some high-volume outbound use cases.
ThunderPhone numbers: US numbers at $1 per month per number (pricing page).
pricing.freeTrial: $10 of free call credit on every new account, no credit card required.
whatIsExtra: Premium voices and selected languages (up to +3 cents per minute)
Long prompts, supervision and Storm options (see plan notes)
ThunderPhone-provided phone numbers ($1 per month plus 1 cent per minute for inbound)
Outbound telephony on your own carrier

strengths.claim: Very low, flat all-in per-minute pricing with no platform fee and a cheaper flat rate while on hold.
Agent importers for Vapi, Retell, ElevenLabs Agents and Bland via API key or JSON export, with a review step before anything is created.
Built-in operations tooling: A/B experiments, AI-graded test calls, live call supervision, validation sets, campaigns with timezone windows and retries, and client portals.
States HIPAA, GDPR and UK GDPR compliance with a BAA and DPA at no extra charge and a public trust center.
Carrier flexibility: native SIP trunking, bring-your-own numbers via Twilio, Telnyx, SignalWire, Vonage, Plivo, and 40+ languages understood.

limitations.claim: The all-in base rates exclude premium voices, selected languages, long prompts and ThunderPhone numbers, which are separate per-minute add-ons.
Cold outbound that is TCPA-compliant is offered as a separate human-agent service (ThunderHuman) rather than by the AI platform alone.
ThunderPhone numbers are US numbers on the pricing page; the vendor says to bring your own carrier for outbound.

integrations: Google, Slack and HubSpot app connections

compliance.note: Stated by vendor, self-attested: the trust center lists HIPAA, GDPR and UK GDPR as compliant with 107 controls monitored; BAA and DPA at no extra charge. SOC 2 is not named on the pages read.

telephony.providedNumbers: US numbers from ThunderPhone at $1 per month per number plus 1 cent per minute inbound; own numbers via Twilio, Telnyx (by API key) or SignalWire, Vonage, Plivo and any SIP trunk.

stepsToLeave: No export procedure was found on the pages read; the vendor's docs describe importing agents in, and expose an API for agents.
Prompts, tools and knowledge documents would need to be copied out through the dashboard or API and recreated in the new platform.
Numbers you brought from a carrier stay with that carrier and can be repointed; ThunderPhone-provided numbers would need a replacement.

bestFor: Cost-sensitive teams that want a flat per-minute price and an easy path to move existing agents over from other platforms.

sources.title: ThunderPhone docs: pricing and usage charges

unknowns: How to export agents out of ThunderPhone was not documented on the pages read.
Company age, customer base and independent reliability data were not checked; the vendor markets a 2.0 launch.
Benchmark claims (for example Big Bench Audio) and competitor price comparisons on the vendor's pages are the vendor's own and were not verified.
Country coverage for ThunderPhone-provided numbers beyond the US was not found.
